summary: The video presents a landscape post-processing workflow focused on a Coal Mine Canyon scene. The speaker outlines a multi-pass approach to managing dynamic range, starts with preserving sky and shadow detail, and then iterates color and light with two RAW passes. Key moves include darkening the sky to retain color, painting in light on canyon features, and employing a sequence of color adjustments (split toning, selective color on reds) before more aggressive enhancements. A standout portion is a manual, paint-by-hand technique to introduce warm light onto rock faces, followed by diffusion and luminosity adjustments to unify tonality. The workflow includes a clone-smear sky replacement to add depth and three-dimensionality, blending sky color into edge regions, and finishing touches with dehaze, HDR tone-mapping, grain management, and targeted cleanup. Throughout, the instructor emphasizes preserving edge behavior, creating a fusion between land and sky, and iterating toward a cohesive, high-contrast landscape with strong atmospheric feel.

sections.title: Composition and initial dynamic range planning
sections.description: Framing discussion of Coal Mine Canyon with a lead-in bowl shape and pillars; introduces intent to expand dynamic range by managing shadows and highlights.

sections.title: Shadow detail retention and sky darkening strategy
sections.description: Advocates expanding dynamic range using blacks or shadows, preferring shadows to preserve detail; plans to keep the sky very dark to hold color before other edits.

sections.title: Two-pass RAW processing and initial color direction
sections.description: Mentions creating two versions of the image and performing RAW adjustments (contrast, overall exposure) and introducing a split tone approach for color control.

sections.title: Edge light painting and horizon glow planning
sections.description: Outlines painting light on key features, adding glow to reduce harsh horizon lines, and aiming for a diffuse sky to merge land and sky.

sections.title: Critical area sharpening and horizon integration rationale
sections.description: Discusses the importance of a strong, well-blended area and how horizon-sky integration affects perceived depth and scale.

sections.title: Color grading refinements: dehaze, split tone, and color matching
sections.description: Delves into dehaze for sky pop, split toning to shape highlight color, and selective color tweaks to push reds warmer and more yellow.

sections.title: Hand-painted light and edge shaping on canyon walls
sections.description: Demonstrates meticulous, hand-painted light on rock faces to sculpt tone and emphasize three-dimensional forms.

sections.title: Global diffusion, luminosity boosts, and sun highlight refinement
sections.description: Applies global diffusion to tie textures together; uses multiple diffusion passes and targeted luminosity boosts to enhance sun-lit regions.

sections.title: Final polish: color passes, HDR mapping, and artifact cleanup
sections.description: Performs final colorizing in RAW, auto HDR tone mapping, luminance/grain balancing, and artifact removal via healing/clone tools.

sections.title: Closing discussion: down-below view and wrap-up
sections.description: Mentions a secondary Coal Mine view and wraps up the session with candid remarks about shooting and processing choices.
